name: Tabbaoth
overview: Tabbaoth is a male descendant of the tribe of Levi who served as a temple servant. His role is specifically noted in the context of temple service, indicating his involvement in the religious duties associated with the Levitical priesthood. There are no additional personal details recorded about him beyond his service and tribal affiliation.
namesAndTitles: The name Tabbaoth means "[ornamental or signet] ring," which may imply a symbol of authority or distinction. This proper name is not indicated to have been given directly by God but is recorded in Scripture as is.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture records Tabbaoth as a descendant of Levi, linking him to the priestly tribe responsible for temple duties. Beyond this tribal relationship, no further family connections are documented.
scriptureSignificance: Tabbaoth's significance lies in his role as a temple servant within the Levitical system, underscoring the importance of faithful service in God's house. His mention in Ezra 2:43 highlights the restoration and reorganization of temple personnel following the exile, reflecting the continuity of God's covenant people and their worship practices.
